verdict.rationale: Whether customer data is used for AI training is a fair privacy question for a SaaS analytics product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no opt-out from AI or model training. Data-retention settings and the User Deletion API are adjacent controls and earn no credit, and the marketing page's mention of Google machine learning does not describe any training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
